import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
titanic = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a factor plot for survival rate by passenger class and sex
g = sns.catplot(
    data=titanic, kind="bar",
    x="pclass", y="survived", hue="sex",
    ci="sd", palette="muted", alpha=.6, height=6
)

# Add labels and title
g.set_axis_labels("Passenger Class", "Survival Rate")
g.fig.suptitle("Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex on the Titanic", y=1.03)
g.add_legend(title="Sex")

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
